title: Midterms: Democrats Projected to Flip the House, Win North and South Carolina Senate Seats
detail: Democrats are projected to win control of the House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections and to flip Senate seats in North Carolina (Roy Cooper wins) and South Carolina from the Republicans, per early projections and reporting.

title: Democrats Take Control of Congress in Midterms, Major Setback for Trump
detail: The Guardian's live midterm coverage reports Democrats taking control of Congress in the 2026 midterm elections, a major setback for President Trump. Results are still being counted in several races.
